versions.changelog: Renamed provider key from custom-api-fastrouter-ai to fastrouter
Renamed provider key from custom-go-fastrouter-ai to custom-api-fastrouter-ai
Replaced Python script with native tool instructions. No script execution or approval needed except for gateway restart.

Initial release of fastrouter-setup skill:

- Adds FastRouter as a model provider to OpenClaw using a user-supplied API key.
- Fetches all available text and vision models live from the FastRouter API.
- Updates the OpenClaw config and restarts the gateway automatically.
- Handles setup triggers, missing API keys, API errors, and incorrect key formats.
- Informs users about added models and how to use them after setup.
